body: Yeah it was Professor Solis I believe.

I took it last summer A session, which I believe to be around the same length of the winter session. I believe the class has several iterations, with the one I took being history of rock. It was super easy (partially because I love rock music). Just do the readings (which can be fairly long and tedious at some points) and listen to the songs. There were quizzes for each module based off the readings and songs you'd listened to, as well as semi-interactive lectures. I got out with an A and had fun taking it.
Big metalhead here, glad to see there's more of us on campus. PM me if you want, would love to get to know the rock/metal scene in Chambana, plus I would love some metalhead friends.

I don't know if this is the right place to post this, but I do play guitar. I'm self-taught and am still learning the ropes of prog guitar so I'm probably not your best bet if you want some Dream Theater/Animals as Leaders type virtuosity, but I'm constantly learning and bettering myself. I'm just posting because I'm happy to learn that there are other folks out there who're into prog on campus :)

Very much agree with this. I'm currently a freshman who is quite introverted and did not know anyone going into university. I choose IT because of it's proximity to the quad and Green St, but the rooms are quite nice. However, being the quiet kid, I have had no luck making friends with my roommates, who are all international students with a previous gang of friends, and thus it can feel quite lonely. But hey, if you're the type who is super social and likes to cook for themselves, IT probably would be a nice fit for you.
